name: std::chrono::year_month_weekday_last::year_month_weekday_last
intro: Constructs a year_month_weekday_last object storing the year y, the month m, and the weekday wdl.weekday(). The constructed object represents the last weekday of that year and month.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: A year_month_weekday_last can also be created by combining one of the partial-date types std::chrono::year_month and std::chrono::month_weekday_last with the missing component (weekday_last and year, respectively) using operator/.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Represent a valid calendar component or date in March 2024, then convert it to text.
